references.text: Ai is first mentioned as a target for Israel's attack, and Bethel is associated with this area
God gives Joshua the command to attack Ai, and the strategy of an ambush is introduced
Describes how the men from Ai pursued Israel and were drawn away from the city
The result of leaving the city open - the ambush took the city, and no one from Ai survived
A similar war strategy where Israel pretended to flee to draw the enemy away from the city
Parallel to Joshua's ambush strategy against Gibeah, where the city was left unprotected
Bethel is mentioned in connection with Abraham's journey, the same geographical area as in Joshua
